setup_dist: setup a distributed process group for multi-GPU PyTorch training with a specified device
get_device: get the current CUDA or CPU device for torch.distributed training
load_state_dict: load a PyTorch model state dict file from disk without redundant fetches across ranks
sync_params: synchronize a sequence of PyTorch tensors across distributed ranks from rank 0
find_free_port: find an available free TCP port on the local machine for distributed training
